items.title: The Wife He Wrote Off
items.author: Lena Marsh
items.desc: At our company Christmas party, in front of four hundred people, my husband thanked his CFO for making the year possible. Then he thanked me for my patience. The room laughed. That night I found the email where Gideon Thorne called our four-year marriage a sunk cost, something he'd write off once his billion-dollar deal closed. On Christmas Eve I asked him if we were all right. He told me we were fully covered. So I left my ring on the dining table, packed one suitcase and a green tin box, and drove the twenty-two minutes to my father's house. Gideon has spent his whole life making sure…

items.title: The Price
items.author: Joan Johnston
items.desc: A powerful New York Times bestseller by the queen of Texas romance, The Price is a compelling contemporary romantic suspense novel of intrigue, passion, ambition, and love set amid Houston’s towering skyscrapers and the majestic plains of South Texas ranch country.
